degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.

description.text: Teaching Objectives After the course you will be equipped the knowledge of Civil engineering discipline and professional training experience for engineers; Qualified ability for the work of planning, design, construction, management and research in civil engineering projects. Graduates will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies. Main Courses Advanced Math,Physics,Theoretical Mechanics,Building materials,Material Mechanics,Structural Mechanics,Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering,Concrete Structure,Steel Structure,and Architecture Construction,Elementary Chinese, Survey of China, Intermediate Chinese, etc. Laboratory equipment and supply(click the pics to enlarge) Laboratory equipment of BUCEA Laboratory equipment of BUCEA Laboratory equipment of BUCEA International Students' graduation ceremony(click the pics to enlarge) Guests visit the lab in BUCEA(click the pics to enlarge) Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Career You will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Beijing University of Civil Engineering and Architecture is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.High School degree diploma 2.High school transcript 3.Aged 25 or below 4.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4 or above

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate 2.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport
